uncertainty: window_s is the recognizer's word segment [start, end]. The spoken onset was not measured. When abuts_previous_word is true the segment may begin in the pause before the word, so the onset can lie anywhere up to the segment end. A recognizer can also place a word late; no bound outside the window is claimed. sample_24k is round(start x 24000) on the decoded take's timeline.
